Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attaching the Order Form you sent (v3) with our suggested redlines and the MSA excerpt we referenced. Two quick asks from procurement/legal to keep the procurement queue moving:

1) Certificate of Insurance (COI): we need a COI showing the following minimum limits: Commercial General Liability 1,000,000 / 2,000,000 aggregate, Automobile Liability 1,000,000, and Professional/Errors & Omissions 1,000,000.

2) Additional Insured endorsement: ProspectCo needs to add Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured on the CG policy with primary & non-contributory wording. If your broker prefers an alternate formulation, can they provide the full endorsement text for our counsel to review?

3) Waiver of Subrogation: procurement is requesting waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood where permitted by law.

We can accept a COI + scanned endorsement for initial onboarding; final countersign will require the insurer endorsement or binder that matches the wording.

Looping in Dev (legal) and Lauren (sales ops) so they have visibility — Dev, if you see anything in the redlines that should change on the insurance front, flag it.

Next step: Sarah, can you confirm whether your broker can produce the COI with the additional insured endorsement by EOD Wednesday? If there are timing constraints, let us know and we can propose a short interim acceptance (COI + email confirmation from broker).

Best,

Hi all —

Thanks for the note, Aditya. Per ProspectCo's broker desk: we can issue a COI showing the requested limits and we can produce an Additional Insured endorsement (CG 20 10 or equivalent) with primary & non-contributory language. A couple things to flag:

- The CG 20 10 form is standard but some carriers prefer an 'endorsement by endorsement text' approach; we can provide the exact endorsement wording ahead of time.
- Waiver of Subrogation: insurer approval depends on the policy and state law, but typically we can add it for most commercial lines.
- Professional liability: if ProspectCo uses a separate E&O policy, we will need the insurer name and policy number to reflect that on the COI.

I'll attach the draft COI and a draft endorsement (scanned PDF) as soon as underwriting confirms — aiming for EOD Thursday. If Redwood legal needs the raw endorsement language, tell me and I will request it from underwriting.

Regards,

Thanks Brian — quick legal recs from my side:

- Additional Insured: we need the endorsement to apply to ongoing operations and completed operations where available (so Ongoing + Completed Operations coverage). Please confirm if CG 20 10 plus CG 20 37 (completed ops) will be included or whether your carrier will use a custom endorsement.

- Primary & Non-contributory: the endorsement must include language that makes ProspectCo's policy primary to any other policy covering Redwood for the same loss. If the broker cannot provide that exact phrase, provide the insurer's substitute language for our review.

- Limits alignment: the COI should match the limits identified in the redlines. If E&O is provided under a different carrier, we need the E&O COI showing the policy number and which entity is listed as the insured.

- Timing: we can accept a scanned endorsement + COI for signature clearance, but final countersign will be contingent on receiving the insurer-signed endorsement or final binder within 30 days.

If you can upload the endorsement draft to the Drive link Aditya included, we'll do a quick pass and respond with any narrow edits.

-Dev
